tha-ap402:1.1: Ajita.] Padumuttaro nāma jino sabbadhammāna pāragū / ajjhogāhetvā Himavantaṃ nisīdi lokanāyako. // //
tha-ap402:2.1: Nāham addakkhiṃ sambuddhaṃ na pi saddaṃ suṇom' ahaṃ / mamaṃ bhikkhaṃ gavesanto āhiṇḍāmi vane ahaṃ. // //
tha-ap402:3.1: Tatth' addasāsiṃ sambuddhaṃ dvattiṃsavaralakkhaṇaṃ / disvāna cittam āpajjiṃ: satto ko nām' ayaṃ bhave? // //
tha-ap402:4.1: Lakkhaṇāni viloketvā mama vijjam anussariṃ / sutaṃ hi me taṃ Buddhānaṃ paṇḍitānaṃ subhāsitaṃ. // //
tha-ap402:5.1: Tesaṃ tathā taṃ vacanam: ayaṃ Buddho bhavissati / yannunāhaṃ sakkareyyaṃ gatiṃ me sodhayissati. // //
tha-ap402:6.1: Khippam assamam āgantvā dumatelaṃ gahim ahaṃ / kolambakaṃ gahetvāna upagacchiṃ vināyakaṃ. // //
tha-ap402:7.1: Tidaṇḍake gahetvāna abbhokāse ṭhapes' ahaṃ / padīpaṃ pajjaletvāna aṭṭhakkhattum avand' ahaṃ. // //
tha-ap402:8.1: Sattarattindivaṃ Buddho nisīdi purisuttamo / tato ratyā vivasane vuṭṭhāsi lokanāyako. // //
tha-ap402:9.1: Pasannacitto sumano sabbarattindivam ahaṃ / dīpaṃ Buddhassa pādāsiṃ pasanno sehi pānihi. // //
tha-ap402:10.1: Sabbe vanā gandhamayā pabbate Gandhamādane / Buddhass' ānubhāvena upagacchuṃ tadā jinaṃ. // //
tha-ap402:11.1: Ye keci pupphagandhā ye pupphitā dharaṇīruhā / Buddhass' ānubhāvena sabbe sannipatuṃ tadā. // //
tha-ap402:12.1: Yāvatā Himavantamhi nāgā ca garuḷā ubho / dhammañ va sotukāmā te āgacchuṃ Buddhasantike. // // Devalo
tha-ap402:13.1: nāma samaṇo Buddhassa aggasāvako / vasīsatasahassehi Buddhasantik' upāgami. // //
tha-ap402:14.1: Padumuttaro lokavidū āhutīnaṃ paṭiggaho / bhikkhusaṅghe nisīditvā imā gāthā abhāsatha: // //
tha-ap402:15.1: Yo me dīpaṃ padīpesi pasanno sehi pānihi / tam ahaṃ kittayissāmi: suṇotha mama bhāsato: // //
tha-ap402:16.1: Saṭṭhiṃ kappasahassāni devaloke ramissati / sahassakkhattuṃ rājā ca cakkavattī bhavissati. // //
tha-ap402:18.1: Chattiṃsakkhattuṃ devindo devarajjaṃ karissati / pathaviyaṃ sattasataṃ vipulaṃ rajjaṃ karissati /
tha-ap402:19.1: padesarajjaṃ vipulaṃ gaṇanāto asaṅkhiyaṃ. // // Iminā dīpadānena dibbacakkhu bhavissati /
tha-ap402:20.1: samantato aḍḍhakosaṃ passissati ayaṃ sadā. // // Devalokā cavantassa nibbattantassa jantuno /
tha-ap402:21.1: divā vā yadi vā rattiṃ padīpaṃ dhārayissati / jāyamānassa santassa puññakammasamaṅgiṇo. // //
tha-ap402:22.1: Yāvatā nagaram āsi tāvatā jotayissati / upapajjati yaṃ yoniṃ devattam atha mānusaṃ. // //
tha-ap402:23.1: Ass' eva dīpadānassa aṭṭhadīpaphalena hi / *na* jahissant' imaṃ jantuṃ dīpadānass' idaṃ phalaṃ. // //
tha-ap402:24.1: Kappasatasahassamhi Okkākakulasambhavo / Gotamo nāma nāmena satthā loke bhavissati. // //
tha-ap402:25.1: Tassa dhammesu dāyādo oraso dhammanimmito / sabbāsave pariññāya nibbāyissat' anāsavo. // //
tha-ap402:26.1: Tosayitvāna sambuddhaṃ Gotamaṃ Sakyapuṅgavaṃ / Ajito nāma nāmena hessati satthu sāvako. // //
tha-ap402:27.1: Saṭṭhiṃ kappasahassāni devaloke ramim ahaṃ / tatrāpi me dīpasataṃ jotare niccakālikaṃ. // //
tha-ap402:28.1: Devaloke manusse vā niddhāvanti pabhā mama / Buddhasetthaṃ saritvāna bhiyyo bhāsaṃ janes' ahaṃ. // //
tha-ap402:29.1: Tusitāhaṃ cavitvāna okkamiṃ mātukucchiyā / jāyamānassa santassa āloko vipulo ahu. // //
tha-ap402:30.1: Agārā abhinikkhamma pabbajim anagāriyaṃ / Bāvarim upasaṅkamma sissattham ajjhupāgamiṃ. // //
tha-ap402:31.1: Himavante vasanto 'haṃ assosiṃ lokanāyakaṃ / uttamatthaṃ gavesanto upagacchiṃ vināyakaṃ. // //
tha-ap402:32.1: Danto Buddho ca medhāvī oghatiṇṇo nirūpadhī / nibbānaṃ kathayi Buddho sabbadukkhappamocanaṃ. // //
tha-ap402:33.1: Tam me āgamanaṃ siddhaṃ tosito 'haṃ mahāmuniṃ / tisso vijjā anuppattā kataṃ Buddhassa sāsanaṃ. // //
tha-ap402:34.1: Satasahasse ito kappe yaṃ dīpam adadiṃ tadā / duggatiṃ nābhijānāmi dīpadānass' idaṃ phalaṃ.
tha-ap402:38.1: Itthaṃ sudam āyasmā Ajito thero i. g. a-ti.
tha-ap402:41.1: Pilindavaccho Selo ca Sabbakittī Madhundado Kūṭāgārī Ba*kulo ca Giri*-Salaḷasavhayo.
tha-ap402:42.1: Sabbado Ajito c' eva gāthāyo gaṇitā-v-iha satāni pañca gāthānaṃ vīsati ca taduttarīti.
tha-ap402:44.1: Padumārakkhado c' eva Ummā Gandhodakena ca Ekapaduma Saddasaññī Mandhāraṃ Bodhivandako
tha-ap402:45.1: Avaṇṭaṃ ca Pilindī ca gāthāyo gaṇitāpi ca catusattati gāthāyo ekadasasatāni ca.
